seams.description: api <-> job store: POST handler creates a job, polling reads status, download reads pdf_ref; divergence risk = job_id format, status vocabulary, error shapes between handler and JobStore
worker <-> renderer: worker calls render_report_pdf(customer, lang) and stores bytes; divergence risk = signature drift, exception propagation (must become mark_failed, not a crash), lang passthrough
renderer <-> pdflib_shim: renderer drives open/add_page/add_text/save; divergence risk = label strings hardcoded instead of from C4 tables, page count mismatch, non-%PDF bytes

e2e_gates.scenario: enqueue -> poll -> download happy path: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf returns 202 {job_id}; GET /jobs/{job_id} transitions queued -> done; GET /jobs/{job_id}/download returns bytes starting b'%PDF'
failure propagation: renderer raises (inject a report whose rendering throws) -> job marked failed with error text; polling shows status 'failed'; enqueue itself stays 202
not-found / premature-download: POST for unknown report -> 404 and no job created; GET /jobs/unknown -> 404; GET /jobs/{id}/download while status != done -> 409

real-bytes page count: customer c1 (2 reports) exported through the real shim -> the PDF contains 2 page objects; lang='de' -> German C4 labels (Kunde/Periode/Titel/Kennzahl/Wert) present in the bytes; no lang -> English set
regression: full suite (existing CSV export tests + all new tests) passes; handle_export_csv response shape unchanged
